The '''Kanchen sector''' was in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]]. [[Planet/Legends|Planets]] in the [[Sector/Legends|sector]] included [[Davnar II/Legends|Davnar II]], [[Xa Fel/Legends|Xa Fel]], [[Pakrik Major]], and [[Pakrik Minor]].

The [[Kanchen Sector Conference]] was held annually on the capital world, [[Pakrik Major]].

==History==
During the [[Thrawn campaign]], the [[Battle of Xa Fel (9 ABY)|capture]] of Xa Fel by [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] forces allowed the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] to take control the Kanchen sector.<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] incorrectly places [[Vodran/Legends|Vodran]], [[Spuma]], [[Munto Codru/Legends|Munto Codru]], and [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] in the Kanchen sector. Vodran and Nal Hutta are in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]; Spuma is in the [[Kwymar sector/Legends|Kwymar sector]]; Munto Codru is in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] near [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. ''Rebellion'' also mistakenly places the Kanchen sector in the Outer Rim.
